name: fileit
description: Ask about your FileIt document vault: what expires soon, who a document belongs to, upcoming renewals and bills. Add reminders and people, and update a document's dates.

interface.longDescription:
FileIt keeps a family's important documents in one place: passports, IDs, driver's licenses, vehicle registrations, insurance policies, business licenses and more, for every person and business in the household. FileIt tracks each document's expiry date and reminds you before it lapses, and keeps recurring reminders for bills, rent and renewals.

With FileIt in ChatGPT you can ask, in your own words:
- What expires in the next three months?
- When does my son's passport expire?
- What renewals and bills are due this month?
- Which documents belong to my company?

And, if you allow it when you connect:
- Update a document's expiry or issue date after you renew it
- Add a person to your family
- Add a recurring reminder for a bill or renewal

You sign in to FileIt and choose what ChatGPT may do. It sees only your own account, it can never delete, share or send anything, and you can disconnect it any time in FileIt under Settings, AI apps. Document numbers and the files themselves are never shared with ChatGPT. To connect, turn on AI apps in FileIt under Settings.
defaultPrompt: What documents in my family expire in the next 90 days?
What renewals and bills are coming up this month?
Remind me every year on January 15 to renew the car insurance.
